name: What are the benefits of energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Energy-efficient windows significantly reduce heat transfer, keeping your home cooler in summer and warmer in winter. This can lead to lower energy bills and a more comfortable indoor environment. Key features often include double or triple-pane glass, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and argon or krypton gas fills between panes. These features help block harmful UV rays and improve insulation, contributing to a more sustainable home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Energy-efficient windows reduce energy bills and improve indoor comfort by minimizing heat transfer and blocking UV rays.
